---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Is this a new tool or an improvement to an existing one?**
New tool / Improvement to: <tool name>

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the use case or gap.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want the tool/feature to do.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other tools or workarounds you've tried.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, links to similar tools, etc.

Note: Toolkist tools must run entirely client-side (no backend/server processing of user files) — see [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md) for constraints before proposing something that needs server-side logic.
